**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**


We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

**Job Title**


Advisor, Product Management**What does a successful Product Management Advisor do at Fiserv?**


We are looking for an experienced Product Management Advisor to help drive the strategy, roadmap and delivery of our Card Services API and developer platform. In this role you will own product areas across the card and payments lifecycle, turn client and market needs into clear requirements, and partner closely with engineering, design, sales and clients to ship products that create measurable value. The ideal candidate combines strong product judgement with a solid understanding of payments, APIs and data, and has a track record of delivering software products in a fast\-paced product organization.

**What you will do:**

* Own the product roadmap for assigned areas of the Card Services API and developer portal, from opportunity through launch and adoption.
* Translate client, market and business needs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Prioritize the backlog using data, client impact and business value, and defend trade\-off decisions with stakeholders.
* Partner daily with engineering and design in an agile setup to plan sprints, remove blockers and keep delivery on track.
* Work with API and developer experience to improve documentation, onboarding journeys and self\-service for developer and business users.
* Define success metrics, instrument products and use adoption and usage data to guide the next set of decisions.
* Support go\-to\-market with sales, marketing and client teams through positioning, demos, enablement and pricing inputs.
* Act as a subject matter advisor on card and surroundings product capabilities for internal teams and clients.
* Look beyond the written brief: proactively spot process gaps, propose improvements and raise the bar for how the team plans, builds and ships.

**What you will need to have:**

* 8\-10 years of experience in product management or a closely related product role in a software or technology organization.
* Hands on experience managing API based or platform products, including working with API specifications and developer facing capabilities.
* Working knowledge of the cards, payments, and surroundings financial services domain.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to frame problems, size opportunities and measure outcomes.
* Experience with agile delivery and common product tools such as Jira, Confluence and roadmap or analytics tooling.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence stakeholders across levels and geographies.
* A strong sense of ownership and the drive to go beyond the job description: someone who takes initiative, challenges the status quo and continuously looks for ways to improve the product and the process.
* Soft skills that make teams better: collaboration, adaptability, curiosity, a bias for action and the resilience to keep delivering in a fast changing environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business or a related field.

**What would be great to have:**

* Experience with card issuing, processing or the Fiserv / payments ecosystem.
* Exposure to developer portals, API productization or platform monetization.
* Familiarity with data driven product practices such as A/B testing and product analytics.
* A track record of leading process or ways\-of\-working improvements that lifted team productivity or product quality.
* MBA or equivalent product or business qualification.


Thank you for considering employment with Fiserv. Please:

* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step\-by\-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

**Our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:**


Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.

**Note to agencies:**


Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.

**Warning about fake job posts:**


Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

title: Mobile Tech Lead – Android
description:
\#\#\# Mobile Tech Lead – Android

\*\*Grade:\*\* C1

\*\*Experience:\*\* 8\+ Years

\*\*Technical Leadership:\*\* Minimum 2\+ Years

\*\*Location:\*\* Pune

\*\*Budget:\*\* 23–24 LPA

\#\#\# Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced \*\*Mobile Tech Lead (Android)\*\* to lead the architecture, development, and delivery of scalable Android applications. The ideal candidate will combine strong hands\-on Android development expertise with leadership capabilities to guide engineering teams, drive technical decisions, and ensure high\-quality mobile solutions aligned with business objectives.

\#\#\# Key Responsibilities

\*\*Technical Leadership\*\*

\* Define and drive the Android architecture strategy and technical roadmap.

\* Lead the design and development of robust, scalable, and maintainable Android applications.

\* Establish coding standards, best practices, and software engineering principles.

\* Conduct architecture reviews and code reviews.

\* Evaluate and recommend new technologies, frameworks, and tools.

\*\*Application Development\*\*

\* Design, develop, test, and deploy Android applications using Kotlin and Java.

\* Build reusable components and libraries.

\* Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and security.

\* Integrate RESTful APIs and third\-party services.

\* Ensure compatibility across multiple Android devices and OS versions.

\*\*Team Leadership \& Mentoring\*\*

\* Lead, mentor, and coach Android developers.

\* Support technical problem\-solving and skill development.

\* Promote knowledge sharing and continuous learning.

\* Assist in hiring, onboarding, and performance evaluations.

\*\*Agile Delivery \& Stakeholder Management\*\*

\* Work closely with Product Owners, UX/UI Designers, QA, and business stakeholders.

\* Participate in sprint planning, estimation, backlog grooming, and retrospectives.

\* Identify risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans.

\* Provide technical guidance and project status updates.

\#\#\# Required Technical Skills

\*\*Android Development\*\*

\* Strong expertise in \*\*Kotlin and Java\*\*.

\* Extensive experience with Android SDK and Android Studio.

\* Hands\-on experience with \*\*Jetpack Compose\*\* and traditional Android UI frameworks.

\* Strong understanding of Material Design principles.

\* Experience with Android Architecture Components.

\*\*Architecture \& Design Patterns\*\*

\* Expertise in \*\*MVVM, MVP, Clean Architecture, and modular architecture\*\*.

\* Strong knowledge of dependency injection frameworks such as \*\*Hilt or Dagger\*\*.

\* Experience designing scalable and maintainable mobile architectures.

\*\*APIs \& Integration\*\*

\* RESTful APIs and GraphQL services.

\* JSON parsing and network libraries such as \*\*Retrofit and OkHttp\*\*.

\* Firebase and third\-party SDK integrations.

\*\*Testing \& Quality\*\*

\* JUnit, Espresso, Mockito, and automated testing frameworks.

\* Strong focus on code quality, maintainability, and test coverage.

\* Familiarity with SonarQube and static code analysis tools.

\*\*DevOps \& CI/CD\*\*

\* Git, GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket.

\* CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar tools.

\* Play Store deployment and release management.

\#\#\# Required Leadership Competencies

\* Proven experience leading Android development teams.

\* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

\* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

\* Ability to influence technical decisions across teams.

\* Experience managing technical debt and platform modernization initiatives.

\#\#\# Preferred Qualifications

\* Experience with Flutter or React Native.

\* Knowledge of mobile security best practices and OWASP Mobile standards.

\* Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

\* Exposure to Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, and AppDynamics.

\* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

\#\#\# Education

\* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

\#\#\# Key Competencies

\* Android Architecture

\* Technical Leadership

\* Team Mentoring

\* Agile Delivery

\* Mobile Security

\* Performance Optimization

\* Stakeholder Management

\* CI/CD and DevOps

\* Innovation and Problem Solving

Pay: Up to ₹2,400,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person
